title: Geriatric Assessment for Older Kidney Transplantation Candidates
summary: Geriatric assessment is now widely used to decide whether older patients with chronic kidney disease should be put on the kidney transplantation waiting list. This study aims to evaluate the association between Geriatric assessment and inscription on kidney transplantation.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients addressed for Geriatric assessment before inscription on kidney transplantation waiting list in Caen University Hospital, France

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient refusal
* Patient unable to provide informed consent
